Force Multiplier

Five practical functions. Scheduling uses a 100-repetition checkerboard battle rhythm with a progressive Phase Flow reveal; the other functions retain their 20-level visual games. Analysis uses an open-entry 20-metric acquisition workup with click-to-reveal arithmetic, Show Me the Right Answer, organic Big Boss questions for each metric, and a directly accessible Improvement Laboratory that walks a fictional case through the eight-step CPI “Nobel Prize” toolbox, including problem statement, breakdown, root cause, implementation, verification, and standardize/share with a 13-test Fishbone Test Builder that includes a calculated fictional worked example for every test and can also analyze local-session CSV data. The 100 transferable skills remain underneath as the curriculum map; completed levels can be replayed with changing conditions, plus optional Worlds practice. Every graded interaction now uses a consistent smile/frown feedback system with optional rotating sounds, and trainees can use Next Exercise to skip ahead without earning independent mastery credit.

Training boundaries

These are fictional exercises for learning scheduling, analysis, documentation, database management and data integrity. They are not operational maintenance instructions, medical or safety guidance, official policy, or occupational certification. Follow your organization’s authorized procedures in real work.

No endorsement by any government, military organization, employer or aircraft manufacturer is claimed. Game stars and simulated reviewer feedback are not evidence of measured learning gains or real participant research.

Privacy and local data

The bundled iOS app runs its exercises offline. The Fishbone lab can optionally read a CSV or pasted table for the current session; raw imported rows are kept in memory only and are not intentionally written into saved progress. Do not load classified, CUI, PII, medical, export-controlled, or other sensitive operational information. This release contains no advertising or analytics SDK, account sign-in, or app-operated server upload. Game progress, settings, work products and any reviewer names or notes you enter are stored in this app on this device. Do not enter classified, controlled, sensitive operational or personal information.

Your progress does not automatically synchronize with the website or another device. Uninstalling the app, clearing its data or device loss can remove progress. Device backups, diagnostics and store services may be handled by Apple under your device settings and Apple’s terms.

When you choose to export, the app creates a JSON file and opens the iOS share sheet. You choose where it goes. That recipient or storage provider can then access the file and applies its own policies. The app attempts to remove the temporary export from its cache after the share sheet closes. Cache files may remain if cleanup fails. The web version downloads the file through your browser. Hosting logs on a separately visited website are distinct from this bundled app.

Backup, restore and delete

Export all saved game and earlier workspace progress before reinstalling or changing devices. A backup contains only successfully saved progress and, when present, a preserved recovery copy of damaged game data. Keep it private if you entered names or notes.

Restoring replaces this app’s saved progress after confirmation. Earlier workspace-only backups can still be restored in the earlier workspace’s settings.

Support and release status

This is a release-candidate source package. If testing with its creator, report the specialty, world, level, steps and app version. Do not include sensitive data in bug reports.

The publisher must supply and verify a public support URL and privacy-policy URL before App Store submission. Signing, physical-device testing, content ownership and release authorization still require review.
